name: Improve Skills Library
description: Evidence-driven improvement of skill grades, motor success rates, and skill gap coverage.

steps.title: Grade and prioritize
steps.description: Using skill-introspect: run validate-skills to grade every skill. Derive per-skill usage and failure signals from recent mission trees (work-log-read --hours 72) — look for motor tasks that reference a skill and failed or required retry. Cross-reference brain-telemetry-read --agent motor --failures for dispatch errors. Prioritize by grade-gap × observed-failure-count. Do not assume a per-skill success-rate store exists.
steps.accept_criteria: Ranked list. Top priority skill identified with grade and observed failure evidence from mission trees.

steps.title: Upgrade priority skill
steps.description: Read current SKILL.md and recent motor tool logs. Following SKILL_STANDARD (docs/guides/SKILL_STANDARD.md): add missing layers — procedures first, then error recovery, then examples. Validate grade after edit.
steps.accept_criteria: SKILL.md upgraded to target grade. validate-skills confirms.

steps.title: Test and fill gaps
steps.description: Send 3 test missions exercising upgraded skill. Compare success rate before/after by reviewing the test mission work trees. Check for skill gaps (motor tasks that fail because no matching skill exists) in the recent mission trees. If gap found (≥3 occurrences): using skill-authoring, create new skill.
